question: A company has Microsoft Copilot Studio agents and plans to deploy custom connectors across development, test, and production environments. You need to design an application lifecycle management (ALM) process to ensure consistency and prevent direct editing in production. Which two actions should you include in the design? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Deploy managed solutions to production.
options.B: Include agents and connectors in a solution.
options.C: Deploy unmanaged solutions to production.
options.D: Move the agents between the environments by using data export and import.
options.E: Manually rebuild the agents in each environment.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Đưa agents và custom connectors vào cùng một Solution giúp quản lý và triển khai nhất quán qua Dev, Test và Production. Triển khai Managed Solution lên Production giúp khóa các thành phần, ngăn chỉnh sửa trực tiếp. Unmanaged solutions, xây dựng thủ công hoặc export/import dữ liệu không đáp ứng đầy đủ yêu cầu ALM.

question: A company has multiple AI models that support generation of sales transactions. Each release of the models must be reviewed by a security and compliance team before being deployed to the production environment. The security and compliance team must have access to prior versions to properly determine potential exposures introduced. You need to recommend a solution to evaluate the impact of each deployment to production. The solution must enhance business continuity. What should you recommend?

options.A: Establish a promotion process by using a quality gate.
options.B: Implement version control for all the AI system components.
options.C: Create a central model registry that uses version history.
options.D: Track model retirement schedules to prevent service disruptions.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Central model registry có version history lưu trữ toàn bộ các phiên bản model, cho phép đội security và compliance truy cập phiên bản cũ để so sánh và đánh giá các rủi ro mới trước khi triển khai Production. Quality gate chỉ là bước kiểm duyệt; version control chung không chuyên biệt bằng model registry; retirement schedule chỉ quản lý việc ngừng model.

question: A company has an AI solution named Solution1 deployed to production. Solution1 uses an Azure OpenAI model to generate marketing emails for existing customers. During an internal review, you identify that Solution1 creates different emails depending on customers' traits. You need to recommend a strategy to mitigate the bias. The strategy must adhere to Microsoft responsible AI principles. What should you recommend?

options.A: Retrain the model by using a larger dataset.
options.B: Modify the system instructions of Solution1.
options.C: Modify the contents of the training dataset.
options.D: Modify Solution1 to randomly generate emails for different traits.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Sự thiên vị thường bắt nguồn từ dữ liệu huấn luyện bị mất cân bằng hoặc chứa các định kiến. Cần kiểm tra, làm sạch, cân bằng và bổ sung dữ liệu đại diện trong training dataset để xử lý nguyên nhân gốc. Tạo output ngẫu nhiên hoặc sửa system prompt chỉ xử lý bề mặt; chỉ tăng kích thước dataset mà không cải thiện chất lượng cũng không giải quyết bias.

question: A company uses multiple Microsoft Copilot Studio agents across different channels. You need to recommend a monitoring solution that provides comprehensive telemetry data and performance insights for the agents. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: Application Insights
options.C: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Voice
options.D: Azure Advisor

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Application Insights. Copilot Studio hỗ trợ tích hợp với Azure Application Insights để thu thập telemetry chi tiết như tin nhắn, topic được kích hoạt, lỗi và hoạt động của agent. Công cụ này cũng hỗ trợ phân tích hiệu suất trên nhiều kênh. Azure Advisor tối ưu hạ tầng, Azure DevOps hỗ trợ phát triển/CI-CD, còn Customer Voice chủ yếu dùng cho khảo sát phản hồi.

question: CASE STUDY — This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately from other exam sections. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case study. You must reference the information provided in the case, and you cannot return to the case study after leaving it. Overview — Contoso, Ltd. is a high-tech manufacturing company that uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, and Dynamics 365 Commerce for its North American operations. The company designs and develops innovative products with patents and proprietary technologies that are closely guarded secrets. Contoso wants to adopt AI solutions to scale in preparation for rapid growth and has multiple legal entities and Azure subscriptions. AI Adoption — The CTO must select one Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management or Dynamics 365 Commerce prebuilt AI agent and one custom Microsoft Copilot Studio AI agent to prioritize and deploy. The CIO must ensure that appropriate security labels are assigned to data used by the AI agents. The CFO analyzes ROI, the CISO discovers and inventories AI resources for auditing, and the CEO ensures that all solutions adhere to industry-standard responsible AI practices. All AI initiatives and agents must have a detailed business use case, a defined audience profile, and an estimated ROI. The R&D department already has a custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server containing comprehensive product specifications and compliance data. Prebuilt AI Agent — The CTO has not selected which prebuilt AI agent to use in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management and wants to view available agent templates to identify which agent will add the most business value. Custom AI Agent — The custom AI agent must use data from Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management to answer questions for the manufacturing team as a low-code solution, be accessible from Microsoft Teams, eventually connect to other agents selected by description, select topics based on a description of the query rather than a trigger phrase, answer questions about R&D product specifications using existing technologies, integrate with and be accessible from Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, and use Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management business logic stored outside the application. Analysis, Reporting, and Troubleshooting — The CISO will audit all AI solutions monthly for compliance and security. The CFO will analyze estimated ROI against actual measured efficiencies and adoption quarterly using the Copilot Studio agent usage estimator. The CISO wants to identify how much sensitive data was accessed for a given AI agent run and who accessed it. The CTO wants to track user feedback on the quality of AI agent responses. The CEO wants a quarterly assessment using Microsoft-recommended tools that verify reliability, interpretability, fairness, and compliance. The CFO wants to compare abandoned interactions with resolved conversations to assess Copilot Studio credit usage. What should you include in the custom AI agent design to meet the R&D product specifications and the compliance information requirements? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: An Azure AI Bot Service channel - A REST API
options.C: A custom OData entity - An event trigger
options.D: A custom connector - The MCP server

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Custom connector là cầu nối để low-code agent giao tiếp với hệ thống bên ngoài như MCP server. Sau đó, thêm MCP server vào agent để agent có thể truy cập dữ liệu thông số sản phẩm và thông tin tuân thủ của R&D. Các lựa chọn còn lại không phù hợp với yêu cầu tích hợp MCP server trong Copilot Studio.

question: A company has an AI solution built by using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform. The solution is used by the company's sales, marketing, and customer service teams. You are performing a return on AI investment (ROAI) analysis to evaluate the impact of the solution. You need to identify which measurable business drivers to include in the analysis. Which two business drivers should you identify? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Economic market predictability
options.C: The reduced average case resolution time
options.D: Brand awareness

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Reduced average case resolution time đo được tác động của Copilot trong việc xử lý yêu cầu khách hàng nhanh hơn. Increased employee productivity đo được thời gian tiết kiệm và số lượng công việc nhân viên hoàn thành nhiều hơn nhờ tự động hóa. Market capitalization, economic market predictability và brand awareness không phải là business driver có thể quy trực tiếp cho giải pháp AI.

question: A company plans to implement an AI solution containing a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent and a Microsoft Foundry agent. The solution is stored in a source code repository. A test environment must be used before production, production must be isolated from development and testing, and deployment must be repeatable, fully automated, and require no manual intervention. Which deployment method should you recommend for each agent? NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Export from the source code repository and import to the target environment. - Use an Azure DevOps pipeline.
options.B: Use a Bicep file. - Use a Microsoft Power Platform deployment pipeline.
options.C: Use a Microsoft Power Platform deployment pipeline. - Use a Bicep file
options.D: Use a Microsoft Power Platform deployment pipeline. - Use an Azure DevOps pipeline.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Copilot Studio thuộc Power Platform nên dùng Microsoft Power Platform deployment pipeline để triển khai tự động qua Dev, Test và Prod. Microsoft Foundry phù hợp với Azure DevOps pipeline để thực hiện CI/CD từ source code repository, bảo đảm triển khai lặp lại và không cần thao tác thủ công. Bicep không phải phương thức chính cho Copilot Studio, còn export/import thủ công không đáp ứng đầy đủ yêu cầu tự động hóa.

question: A company uses a fine-tuned Microsoft Foundry model that requires frequent updates as new customer feedback becomes available. You need to design an application lifecycle management (ALM) process that meets the following requirements: Data changes must be tracked and versioned. The model must be retrained consistently by using approved training data. Which two actions should you include in the design? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Create a content filter.
options.B: Store the training data in Azure Blob Storage that has version control enabled.
options.C: Store the training data in Azure Files.
options.D: Associate the storage location to the fine-tuning job.
options.E: Upload the training data to Microsoft Foundry data files.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Upload dữ liệu lên Microsoft Foundry data files giúp quy trình fine-tuning luôn sử dụng dữ liệu đã được phê duyệt. Lưu dữ liệu trong Azure Blob Storage có bật version control giúp theo dõi thay đổi, khôi phục phiên bản cũ và kiểm toán dữ liệu dùng cho mỗi lần fine-tune. Content filter và Azure Files không đáp ứng yêu cầu ALM/versioning này.

question: A company has an AI solution that uses Azure OpenAI models. You need to recommend a governance solution that monitors and audits changes to model configurations and data usage. The solution must minimize administrative effort. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: Azure Policy
options.C: Azure API Management
options.D: Azure Monitor

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Microsoft Purview. Purview cung cấp khả năng quản trị, quản lý dữ liệu, theo dõi việc sử dụng dữ liệu và kiểm toán các tài nguyên AI với ít công sức quản trị. Azure Monitor chủ yếu giám sát hiệu suất và trạng thái vận hành; Azure Stream Analytics xử lý dữ liệu luồng; Azure API Management quản lý API; Azure Policy thực thi các quy tắc cấu hình nhưng không cung cấp đầy đủ khả năng quản trị dữ liệu và kiểm toán AI như Purview.

question: A company has a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that has been in production for three months. The agent has received positive feedback from users. You need to identify the number of questions unanswered by the agent and the number of abandoned sessions between the users and the agent. Which Copilot Studio insights should you use? To answer, drag the appropriate insights to the correct requirements. Each insight may be used once, more than once, or not at all. You may need to drag the split bar between panes or scroll to view content. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Generated answer rate and quality — Conversation outcomes
options.C: Conversation outcomes — Generated answer rate and quality
options.D: Survey results — Generated answer rate and quality

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Số lượng câu hỏi chưa được trả lời được xem trong Generated answer rate and quality. Số lượng phiên bị bỏ dở được xem trong Conversation outcomes, vì insight này phân loại kết quả phiên hội thoại như Resolved, Escalated và Abandoned. Reactions và Survey results chủ yếu dùng để phân tích phản hồi hoặc khảo sát người dùng.

question: A company uses Azure OpenAI models that use grounding data from Microsoft Fabric for agents. The models are fine-tuned by using proprietary datasets. You need to design a governance solution that restricts access to the grounding data to assigned roles and restricts model fine-tuning to only the AI engineering team. What should you include in the design?

options.A: Role-based access control (RBAC) in Microsoft Foundry - Microsoft Purview access policies
options.B: Azure Monitor alerts - Microsoft Entra Conditional Access
options.C: Azure Policy compliance rules - Azure Resource Manager (ARM) resource locks
options.D: Microsoft Purview access policies - Role-based access control (RBAC) in Microsoft Foundry

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Microsoft Purview access policies dùng để quản lý quyền truy cập vào grounding data trong Microsoft Fabric dựa trên vai trò. Role-based access control (RBAC) trong Microsoft Foundry dùng để giới hạn quyền thực hiện fine-tuning cho đội ngũ kỹ thuật AI. Azure Monitor chỉ giám sát và cảnh báo; Azure Policy kiểm tra cấu hình tài nguyên; resource locks chủ yếu ngăn xóa hoặc sửa tài nguyên; Conditional Access kiểm soát điều kiện đăng nhập.

question: You are designing a testing solution for a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that integrates with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Dynamics 365 Sales. You need to design end-to-end scenarios to test the agent's ability to coordinate tasks and data interactions across both apps, interpret user input, and provide contextually relevant outputs. Which test scenario and metric should you include in the design?

options.A: Test scenario: Run task-based scenarios that involve both apps; Metric: Track the successful completion of cross-app tasks
options.B: Test scenario: Run task-based scenarios that involve both apps; Metric: Track the average click rate across both apps
options.C: Test scenario: In each app, test isolated tasks without using workflows; Metric: Measure the initial prompt response time for each app
options.D: Test scenario: Test visual consistency across both apps; Metric: Track the successful completion of cross-app tasks

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Vì yêu cầu là kiểm thử khả năng phối hợp tác vụ và dữ liệu giữa Customer Service và Sales, cần chạy các kịch bản dựa trên tác vụ có liên quan đến cả hai ứng dụng. Chỉ số phù hợp là tỷ lệ hoàn thành thành công các tác vụ chéo ứng dụng. Kiểm thử riêng lẻ, thời gian phản hồi ban đầu, tỷ lệ click hoặc tính nhất quán giao diện không đo trực tiếp khả năng hoàn thành luồng nghiệp vụ liên ứng dụng và trả về kết quả đúng ngữ cảnh.

question: A company has a Microsoft Copilot Studio prompt-and-response agent. You need to ensure that the agent provides effective and relevant responses and provides conversational outcomes. Which metric should you use for each requirement?To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Reactions - Satisfaction
options.C: Generated answer rate and quality - Topics by outcome
options.D: Generated answer rate and quality - Tool use

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Generated answer rate and quality đánh giá tỷ lệ và chất lượng các câu trả lời tạo sinh, qua đó xác định phản hồi có hiệu quả và phù hợp hay không. Topics by outcome theo dõi kết quả của các cuộc hội thoại, chẳng hạn Resolved, Escalated hoặc Abandoned. Reactions/Satisfaction phản ánh phản hồi người dùng, còn Tool use đo việc sử dụng công cụ.

question: ASE STUDY This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately from other exam sections. You can use as much exam time as you would like to complete each case study. However, there might be additional case studies or other exam sections. Manage your time to ensure that you can complete all the exam sections in the time provided. Pay attention to the Exam Progress at the top of the screen so you have sufficient time to complete any exam sections that follow this case study. To answer the case study questions, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case. Case studies and associated questions might contain exhibits or other resources that provide more information about the scenario described in the case. Information provided in an individual question does not apply to the other questions in the case study. A Review Screen will appear at the end of this case study. From the Review Screen, you can review and change your answers before you move to the next exam section. After you leave this case study, you will NOT be able to return to it. To start the case study - To display the first question in this case study, select the "Next" button. To the left of the question, a menu provides links to information such as business requirements, the existing environment, and problem statements. Please read through all this information before answering any questions. When you are ready to answer a question, select the "Question" button to return to the question. Background - Fabrikam, Inc., is a global consumer goods company that is undergoing a digital transformation initiative to migrate its entire infrastructure to the Microsoft cloud. As a key element of this cloud migration, the company will implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales, moving away from the current on-premises proprietary technologies used by its business-to-business (B2B) sales team. As part of the cloud migration, Fabrikam will adopt an AI-first approach to its business solutions and implement AI solutions, wherever possible, to streamline operations. Problem Statements - Fabrikam's infrastructure currently relies on various on-premises systems that require sales executives to use corporate computers with physical keyboards to access business information during customer interactions. Mobile phones cannot be used for these purposes, as the systems depend on keyboard input. As a result, the sales executives spend a lot of time using keyboards to search for data on several disparate systems and file servers, rather than focusing on the customers. This affects the customer experience. Fabrikam stakeholders are concerned that users will be hesitant to adopt AI. If the AI initiatives are NOT adopted, cost savings will never be realized. Additionally, funding for future AI initiatives will depend on demonstrating an increase in AI adoption month over month. As the AI agent initiative for the sales team will be the first for Fabrikam, the rapid adoption of the agent is a high priority. Planned Initiatives - General - Fabrikam management has prioritized AI-driven projects to improve efficiency, customer engagement, and responsible AI adoption. The current application infrastructure is on-premises and must be migrated to the cloud to support the adoption of these technologies. Infrastructure Migration - Fabrikam plans to migrate from its current on-premises infrastructure to a completely cloud-based topology; this will include user authentication, the security framework, and, primarily, the adoption of the services by end users. All the data from the different systems will be consolidated into a single data source - a common data model that will use a Microsoft Dataverse environment as a single source of truth (SSOT) for the sales team. Sales Cycle Enablement - To achieve the company's objectives, Fabrikam intends to implement the following strategies to enhance the sales cycle: Use low-code development to create a single AI agent that has Dataverse as its core component. Ensure that sales managers can access unanswered correspondence from prospects and intervene as appropriate. Replace the previous proprietary software with Dynamics 365 Sales to track sales cycles and customer interactions. Have the sales executives use Dynamics 365 Sales to track interactions for open opportunities and send follow-up communications to prospects. Have the sales executives use handsfree headsets to interact with an AI agent when they have questions about internal policies or customer data. Requirements - Infrastructure Migration - Fabrikam has identified the following infrastructure migration requirements: Azure must be used for all future infrastructure workloads. The company must follow Microsoft-recommended methodologies for infrastructure migration to the cloud. Any created AI agents must have their return on investment (ROI) calculated to ensure that the solution will save the company money. Sales Cycle Enablement - Fabrikam has identified the following requirements for sales cycle enablement: The final AI agent must follow Microsoft recommendations for a conversational user experience. A designated checklist must be reviewed to ensure that the AI agent follows Microsoft deployment recommendations for a compliant solution. Detailed telemetry must be logged for the first created AI agent to help troubleshoot and optimize the agent during the initial AI agent adoption process. Unexpected AI agent actions must end in an escalation to a live representative. For example, a sales executive must be rerouted to a representative if the agent cannot answer a question after two failed attempts. The return on investment (ROI) of switching from the current process to the future process is required for stakeholder sign off. The sales team must use Dynamics 365 Sales to correspond with prospects more quickly and efficiently than currently. Sales managers must report on the adoption of the AI agent to key Fabrikam stakeholders on a monthly basis. Any sensitive information, such as user IDs and names, shared via the AI agent must be tracked for future auditing. Which tool should you recommend to address the sensitive information concerns in the sales process?

options.A: Monitoring in Microsoft Foundry
options.C: The Analytics tab in Microsoft Copilot Studio
options.D: Microsoft Foundry Tracing UI

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Application Insights. Application Insights cung cấp telemetry và nhật ký chi tiết để theo dõi dữ liệu được trao đổi qua agent, bao gồm thông tin người dùng và user ID, phục vụ truy vấn, khắc phục sự cố và kiểm toán. Analytics trong Copilot Studio chủ yếu cung cấp dashboard tổng quan; MCP là giao thức kết nối; còn các công cụ Foundry không phải lựa chọn tiêu chuẩn cho telemetry/audit chi tiết của Copilot Studio.

question: A company has an Azure environment that supports multiple business units. The company plans to implement an AI solution that will perform sentiment analysis on customer product reviews. You need to evaluate the potential cost of the solution to support return on AI investment (ROAI) analysis. What should you use?

options.A: Azure Monitor
options.C: Azure pricing calculator
options.D: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Azure pricing calculator. Công cụ này cho phép ước tính chi phí các dịch vụ Azure dự kiến sử dụng, chẳng hạn Azure OpenAI hoặc Azure AI Language, trước khi triển khai để phục vụ phân tích ROAI. TCO Calculator dùng để so sánh chi phí hạ tầng tại chỗ và cloud ở quy mô lớn; Azure Reservations là cơ chế tối ưu chi phí sau khi đã có kế hoạch sử dụng; Azure Monitor dùng để giám sát hệ thống đang chạy.

question: A company has multiple Dynamics 365 and Azure resources and is implementing a custom Microsoft Copilot Studio AI agent. Which two components for the custom AI agent should you include in the application lifecycle management (ALM) process? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.A: An X++ model
options.C: A ZIP package
options.D: An Azure package

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Microsoft Power Platform solution là thành phần chuẩn để đóng gói và quản lý agent Copilot Studio cùng các thành phần liên quan trong quy trình ALM giữa Dev, Test và Prod. ZIP package là định dạng gói được sử dụng để xuất, lưu trữ và chuyển giao solution hoặc cấu hình agent. Azure package, CSU package và X++ model không phải thành phần ALM chuẩn cho custom Copilot Studio agent.

question: A company has an Azure environment that supports multiple business units. The company plans to implement an AI solution that will perform sentiment analysis on customer product reviews. You need to evaluate the potential cost of the solution to support return on AI investment (ROAI) analysis. What should you use?

options.A: Microsoft Fabric SKU Estimator
options.C: Azure savings plans
options.D: Azure Monitor

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Cost Management + Billing. Khi môi trường Azure hỗ trợ nhiều đơn vị kinh doanh, công cụ này giúp phân tích chi phí, dự báo chi tiêu, phân bổ chi phí theo đơn vị và thiết lập ngân sách/cảnh báo để phục vụ ROAI. Azure savings plans là cơ chế tối ưu giá; Fabric SKU Estimator chỉ dành cho năng lực Microsoft Fabric; Azure Monitor dùng để giám sát kỹ thuật, không quản lý tài chính.

question: You are designing an AI business solution that contains a Microsoft Power Automate workflow, a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent, a Microsoft Dataverse database, and a Microsoft Power Apps app. As part of the application lifecycle management (ALM) process, you plan to package the components so that they can be deployed to other environments as a group. You need to recommend a solution that supports versioning, dependencies, and deployments. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: Azure DevOps
options.C: GitHub Actions

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Microsoft Power Platform solutions. Solutions là cơ chế cốt lõi của Power Platform để đóng gói Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse và Copilot Studio thành một đơn vị triển khai. Solutions hỗ trợ quản lý phiên bản, dependencies và triển khai giữa các môi trường Dev, Test và Production. GitHub Actions và Azure DevOps là các công cụ CI/CD hỗ trợ; chúng vẫn cần thao tác trên Power Platform solutions.

question: A company deploys agents that generate responses by using Azure OpenAI resources. The agents are deployed to both the United States and Europe. You need to recommend a governance solution that enforces deployment only to approved Azure regions and provides continuous compliance verification of the resources. What should you include in the recommendation for each requirement?

options.A: Azure Policy — Microsoft Defender for Cloud
options.B: Azure Monitor — Microsoft Defender for Cloud

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là : Enforces deployment to approved regions → Azure Policy; Provides continuous compliance verification → Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Azure Policy dùng policy Allowed locations để giới hạn các vùng Azure được phép triển khai. Microsoft Defender for Cloud cung cấp đánh giá liên tục, điểm số và bảng điều khiển tuân thủ cho tài nguyên. Azure Monitor tập trung vào telemetry và hiệu suất, không phải công cụ quản trị tuân thủ chính.

question: Which existing tool and data should you use to gather the required metrics for stakeholder signoff for the AI agents? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Microsoft Copilot Studio — the current time to complete the task today per instance
options.B: Azure Resource Monitor (ARM) — the current cost to complete the tasks per instance
options.C: Microsoft Foundry — the current cost to complete the tasks per instance
options.D: Dynamics 365 Sales — the current cost to complete the tasks per instance

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là : Microsoft Copilot Studio — the current time to complete the task today per instance. Copilot Studio là công cụ low-code dùng để xây dựng và phân tích agent trong case study. Thời gian hiện tại để hoàn thành mỗi tác vụ là dữ liệu nền cần thiết để so sánh quy trình hiện tại với quy trình dùng agent, từ đó tính mức tiết kiệm và ROI phục vụ stakeholder signoff. Chi phí license, ARM và Microsoft Foundry không phản ánh trực tiếp hiệu quả thời gian của quy trình.

question: A company has a Microsoft Foundry generative AI model. You need to evaluate the model's output to measure the overall quality and coherence of generated responses. The evaluation must use GPT-4o as a judge and return a numeric score for each output. Which type of metric should you use?

options.A: risk and safety
options.C: AI quality (AI assisted)
options.D: Groundedness

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là AI quality (AI assisted). Nhóm metric này dùng một mô hình AI khác làm giám khảo; trong câu hỏi, GPT-4o sẽ đánh giá chất lượng và tính mạch lạc rồi trả về điểm số cho từng output. AI quality (NLP) dùng các chỉ số ngôn ngữ truyền thống; risk and safety đánh giá nội dung nguy hiểm; Groundedness đo mức độ bám sát nguồn dữ liệu.

question: A company has a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that uses custom connectors to interact with enterprise APIs. You need to recommend an application lifecycle management (ALM) process to ensure that the connectors are deployed consistently across development, test, and production environments and meet governance and traceability requirements. What should you recommend?

options.A: Maintain connector definitions in environment variables.
options.B: Manage the connectors as solution components and deploy the components by using ALM pipelines.
options.C: Export and import the connectors between the environments as unmanaged solutions.
options.D: Deploy the APIs as Azure Functions.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Custom connectors nên được quản lý như các thành phần của Power Platform solution, sau đó triển khai qua ALM pipelines giữa Dev, Test và Production. Cách này đảm bảo tính nhất quán, governance và traceability. Azure Functions chỉ là nơi chạy API; environment variables chỉ lưu các giá trị thay đổi; unmanaged solutions không phù hợp cho môi trường Test/Production.

question: Which tool should you recommend to help secure funding for future AI agent development?

options.A: Evaluations in Microsoft Foundry
options.C: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
options.D: Azure Operator Insights
options.E: the Analytics tab in Microsoft Copilot Studio

Analytics cung cấp các chỉ số và báo cáo adoption theo thời gian để trình bày cho stakeholders. Các lựa chọn còn lại tập trung vào đánh giá model, tối ưu chi phí, vận hành mạng hoặc huấn luyện model.

question: You are designing a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that uses a custom Microsoft Foundry model to generate responses. You need to ensure that the agent can securely connect to and invoke the custom model during user interactions. What should you include in the design?

options.A: Create a custom engine agent.
options.B: Configure the agent to use classic orchestration.
options.C: Create a connection to Microsoft Foundry in the agent.
options.D: Add the Microsoft Foundry model as a Copilot Studio skill.

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là tạo connection tới Microsoft Foundry trong agent. Connection cung cấp cơ chế xác thực và ủy quyền an toàn để Copilot Studio có thể gọi custom Foundry model trong lúc người dùng tương tác. Classic orchestration, skill hoặc custom engine agent không phải bước cốt lõi để thiết lập kết nối bảo mật trực tiếp với model.

question: A company uses multiple Microsoft Copilot Studio agents across different channels. You need to recommend a monitoring solution that provides comprehensive telemetry data and performance insights for the agents. What should you include in the recommendation?

options.A: the Analytics tab in Copilot Studio
options.C: Microsoft Power BI
options.D: Azure Advisor

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là Log Analytics. Khi cần telemetry toàn diện và thông tin hiệu suất từ nhiều agent, Log Analytics cho phép tập trung, truy vấn và phân tích log bằng KQL, thường kết hợp với Application Insights. Analytics tab phù hợp cho báo cáo cơ bản từng agent; Power BI là công cụ trực quan hóa; Azure Advisor đưa ra khuyến nghị tối ưu hạ tầng.

question: A company is using Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations apps. The company wants to leverage Microsoft Copilot in-app help and guidance to generate responses for its internal business processes. You need to add an additional knowledge source for these business processes. The solution must allow Copilot to access the required information without creating any new topics in the Copilot agent for Finance and Operations. Which knowledge source should you add?

options.A: A file upload
options.C: A public website
options.D: Azure AI Search

explanation: Phương án phù hợp là A file upload. Có thể tải các tài liệu quy trình nội bộ như PDF hoặc Word lên Copilot để Generative Answers sử dụng làm nguồn kiến thức, mà không cần tạo thêm topics. Dataverse, public website và Azure AI Search không phù hợp trực tiếp với yêu cầu bổ sung tài liệu nội bộ nhanh chóng trong câu hỏi.
